title: ARC-WBE 2026 white-box estimation experiment
goal: Develop a white-box estimation method for ARC-WBE 2026. The goal is to minimize the adjusted final-layer score on the WHEST evaluation.
metric: WHEST adjusted final-layer score (lower is better)
requirements: design 2-4 materially different white-box estimation approaches
use the ARC-WBE 2026 weights and framework
select best approach by lowest WHEST score
